options: Pale windows on dark posterior region

Pale median markings; dark lateral bands
White anterior line; two white V-marks
Black stripes separating centre and flanks
Four median sigilla in a trapezoid

options: Robust; lateral condyle present; reddish (erythrognatha = red jaws)
Very long, divergent; row of large teeth

Cordate, about as long as wide

questions.text: What colour pattern does the sternum have?
options: Dark brown with pale median band
Dark brown with pale median mark

questions.text: Sternum length divided by width?
What is the overall shape of the epigyne?
options: About as long as wide, rounded

questions.text: What is the main structure on the epigyne (scape, septum, atria...)?
options: Plate with median septum and posterior lip
Large lateral lobes with median field
No epigynal plate; simple genital slit
Large median plate with anterior hood
Long scape, bent anteriorly then posteriorly
Small plate with posterior median lip
Plate with central depression and anterior hood

How many eyes are there, and how are they arranged?
options: 8 eyes in three rows; anterior median eyes greatly enlarged
8 eyes in three rows (4-2-2); posterior eyes large
8 eyes in two rows; lateral eyes on tubercles

questions.text: Viewed from in front/above, how are the two eye rows curved?
options: Anterior slightly recurved; posterior slightly procurved
Anterior slightly procurved; posterior slightly recurved

Present on tibiae, metatarsi and tarsi
Present on tibiae and metatarsi, and in two prolateral rows on femur IV
